change_summary: Trim policy_summary to only enforced/rule-bearing lines using pure Jinja string ops (no regex_replace filter).
reason_for_change: The domain_policy is the largest constant token block resent on every one of the ~27 turns per task, so shrinking it to just the enforcement-relevant lines (imperatives, prohibitions, conditionals, and enumerated/bulleted rules) directly lowers fixed input tokens per turn and thus mean cost per task. The prior trim was rejected only for a missing regex_replace filter (preflight render error); this version uses only built-in string methods (split, strip, startswith, isdigit, substring membership) that are always available, avoiding the preflight failure while preserving the actionable constraints the agent needs to keep success held.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: accepted: all 2 proxy runs improved mean cost per task within guardrails
hypothesis: policy_summary passes the full domain_policy verbatim on every turn; trimming it to enforced rules using plain Jinja constructs (no regex_replace filter, which caused the prior preflight failure) reduces the large fixed per-turn input cost.
